description: NY IT-214 Real Property Tax Credit (2025 Form IT-214, printed line-12 percentage menu): FAGI $12,368; rent $6,000 including heat+gas+electricity+furnishings (no board) -> 75% menu row -> line 12 adjusted rent = $4,500.00; line 13 average monthly = 4,500/12 = $375 <= $450 cap; line 14 = 25% x 4,500 = $1,125 = line 18; line 19 = FAGI x Table 1 rate 0.060 ($11,001-14,000 bracket) = $742.08 < line 18 -> qualifies.
